web3-dapp-builder v1.0.0

- Initial release of an industry-standard Web3 DApp architecture skill for 2026.
- Supports Account Abstraction (ERC-4337/EIP-7702), embedded wallets, Permit2, and multi-chain (EVM+Solana).
- Covers full-stack setup: Next.js, Fastify, Wagmi/Viem, BullMQ, event-driven SSE, and on-chain indexing.
- Provides best practices for wallet onboarding, gasless UX, strategy orchestration, encrypted credential management, and robust testing.
- Includes decision matrices and detailed architecture diagrams for implementing production-grade DApps.
